slots.title: Replication slots and retained WAL
slots.readOnlyNote: This view is read-only. Lockkeeper never drops a slot from here: cleaning up a slot is an explicit, confirmed step of a migration, and only after a verified cutover.
slots.notApplicableTitle: Replication slots do not apply to MySQL
slots.notApplicableBody: Slots and retained WAL are PostgreSQL concepts. For MySQL, watch replication lag and binary log size in the Metrics tab.
slots.empty: This server has no replication slots.
slots.orphanTitle: An inactive slot is holding WAL
slots.orphanBody_one: {{names}} keeps {{size}} of WAL on the server's disk because nothing is reading it. WAL that is not released keeps growing and can fill the disk, which stops the database. Find out who owns the slot before changing anything.
slots.orphanBody_other: {{names}} keep {{size}} of WAL in total on the server's disk because nothing is reading them. WAL that is not released keeps growing and can fill the disk, which stops the database. Find out who owns these slots before changing anything.
